title: Convergence of evolving artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques in precision oncology

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Convergence of evolving artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques in precision oncology》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The confluence of new technologies with artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) analytical techniques is rapidly advancing the field of precision oncology, promising to improve diagnostic approaches and therapeutic strategies for patients with cancer.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The confluence of new technologies with artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) analytical techniques is rapidly advancing the field of precision oncology, promising to improve diagnostic approaches and therapeutic strategies for patients with cancer.

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】Currently, many operational and technical challenges exist related to data technology, engineering, and storage; algorithm development and structures; quality and quantity of the data and the analytical pipeline; data sharing and generalizability; and the incorporation of these technologies into the current clinical workflow and reimbursement models.
